# This box's /usr/local/bin carries Linux Mint's `apt` wrapper, which
# prefixes sudo for a non-root user and so depends on the developer
# account's own sudo setup. Pin the standard system directories (no
# /usr/local) so the recording is the failure of `apt` itself - the lock
# permission error - on any host, not a local wrapper's sudo text.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
